title: 科技与互联网精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我刚上传的文件为什么还没有出现在共享文件夹里？
items.en: Why hasn't the file I just uploaded appeared in the shared folder yet?
answers: Why hasn't the file I just uploaded appeared in the shared folder yet?
Why has not the file I just uploaded appeared in the shared folder yet?
items.notes: I just uploaded 是省略关系代词的定语从句；yet 用于询问尚未发生的预期结果。

items.zh: 在恢复出厂设置之前，请先备份照片。
items.en: Please back up your photos before restoring the device to its factory settings.
answers: Please back up your photos before restoring the device to its factory settings.
items.notes: back up 是动词短语，backup 常用作名词；before 后接 doing。

items.zh: 如果忘记密码，我还能用备用邮箱登录吗？
items.en: Can I still sign in using my recovery email if I forget my password?
answers: Can I still sign in using my recovery email if I forget my password?
items.notes: sign in 表示登录；using 引出方式，if 引出条件。

items.zh: 虽然无线网络显示已连接，但我打不开任何网页。
items.en: Although the Wi-Fi shows as connected, I can't open any web pages.
answers: Although the Wi-Fi shows as connected, I can't open any web pages.
Although the Wi-Fi shows as connected, I cannot open any web pages.
items.notes: although 对比连接状态与实际功能；否定句用 any。

items.zh: 这个应用一直请求访问通讯录，但我不明白它为什么需要这些信息。
items.en: This app keeps asking for access to my contacts, but I don't understand why it needs this information.
answers: This app keeps asking for access to my contacts, but I don't understand why it needs this information.
This app keeps asking for access to my contacts, but I do not understand why it needs this information.
items.notes: keep doing 表示反复做；access to 表示访问权限，information 不可数。

items.zh: 你发来的链接已经过期，能否重新生成一个？
items.en: The link you sent has expired; could you generate a new one?
answers: The link you sent has expired; could you generate a new one?
items.notes: 定语从句省略关系代词；expire 表示失效，one 代指 link。

items.zh: 让我困惑的是，同一份文件在两个设备上显示的版本不同。
items.en: What confuses me is that the same file shows different versions on the two devices.
answers: What confuses me is that the same file shows different versions on the two devices.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；on a device 表示在设备上。

items.zh: 与其每次手动保存，不如打开自动保存功能。
items.en: Instead of saving manually each time, turn on autosave.
answers: Instead of saving manually each time, turn on autosave.
items.notes: instead of 后接动名词；turn on 表示启用功能。

items.zh: 安装更新后，我的打印机就不再出现在设备列表里了。
items.en: After I installed the update, my printer stopped appearing in the device list.
answers: After I installed the update, my printer stopped appearing in the device list.
items.notes: stop doing 表示停止某种状态；说明变化时点，未把先后关系断言为原因。

items.zh: 请把通知设为静音，直到会议结束。
items.en: Please mute notifications until the meeting is over.
answers: Please mute notifications until the meeting is over.
items.notes: mute 在此作动词；until 引出持续状态的终点。

items.zh: 这张截图显示了错误提示，却没有显示你之前做了什么操作。
items.en: This screenshot shows the error message but not the steps you took beforehand.
answers: This screenshot shows the error message but not the steps you took beforehand.
items.notes: steps you took 中 take steps 指进行操作步骤；beforehand 表示事先。

items.zh: 只有管理员批准后，新成员才能访问这个工作区。
items.en: New members can access this workspace only after an administrator approves them.
answers: New members can access this workspace only after an administrator approves them.
items.notes: only after 表示必要的先后条件；access 是及物动词。

items.zh: 我误删了一个文件，回收站里还能找到它吗？
items.en: I deleted a file by mistake; might it still be in the recycle bin?
answers: I deleted a file by mistake; might it still be in the recycle bin?
items.notes: by mistake：误操作。

items.zh: 这个文件是只读的，我无法保存修改。
items.en: This file is read-only, so I cannot save my changes.
answers: This file is read-only, so I cannot save my changes.
This file is read-only, so I can't save my changes.
items.notes: read-only：只读的。

items.zh: 你能给我查看权限，而不是编辑权限吗？
items.en: Could you give me viewing access rather than editing access?
answers: Could you give me viewing access rather than editing access?
items.notes: rather than 区分两种权限。

items.zh: 请在发送之前把附件压缩一下。
items.en: Please compress the attachment before sending it.
answers: Please compress the attachment before sending it.
items.notes: compress：压缩文件。

items.zh: 视频能播放，但没有声音。
items.en: The video plays, but there is no sound.
answers: The video plays, but there is no sound.
items.notes: play 可用作不及物动词。

items.zh: 我戴着耳机，所以扬声器没有输出声音。
items.en: I have headphones connected, so no sound is coming from the speakers.
answers: I have headphones connected, so no sound is coming from the speakers.
items.notes: have sth connected：处于连接状态。

items.zh: 会议软件提示另一个程序正在使用摄像头。
items.en: The meeting software says another application is using the camera.
answers: The meeting software says another application is using the camera.
items.notes: software 为不可数名词。

items.zh: 屏幕共享时，请只选择相关窗口。
items.en: When sharing your screen, please select only the relevant window.
answers: When sharing your screen, please select only the relevant window.
items.notes: when doing：在执行某操作时。

items.zh: 网页要求启用第三方 Cookie 才能继续。
items.en: The page requires third-party cookies to be enabled before I can continue.
answers: The page requires third-party cookies to be enabled before I can continue.
items.notes: require sth to be done。

items.zh: 我清除了浏览器缓存，但旧页面仍然出现。
items.en: I cleared the browser cache, but the old page still appears.
answers: I cleared the browser cache, but the old page still appears.
items.notes: cache：缓存。

items.zh: 下载进度停在百分之六十，已经十分钟没有变化了。
items.en: The download is stuck at sixty per cent and has not progressed for ten minutes.
answers: The download is stuck at sixty per cent and has not progressed for ten minutes.
The download is stuck at sixty per cent and hasn't progressed for ten minutes.
items.notes: be stuck at：停滞在某个进度。

items.zh: 安装程序说磁盘空间不足。
items.en: The installer says there is not enough disk space.
answers: The installer says there is not enough disk space.
The installer says there isn't enough disk space.
items.notes: disk space 为不可数表达。

items.zh: 这个应用在后台运行时，电池耗得特别快。
items.en: The battery drains especially quickly when this app runs in the background.
answers: The battery drains especially quickly when this app runs in the background.
items.notes: run in the background：后台运行。

items.zh: 我想撤销刚才对位置权限的授权。
items.en: I want to revoke the location permission I just granted.
answers: I want to revoke the location permission I just granted.
items.notes: revoke permission：撤销授权。

items.zh: 手机更换后，双重验证代码不再发到新设备上。
items.en: Since changing phones, I no longer receive two-factor authentication codes on the new device.
answers: Since changing phones, I no longer receive two-factor authentication codes on the new device.
items.notes: no longer：不再。

items.zh: 请不要通过普通聊天发送这个临时密码。
items.en: Please do not send this temporary password through an ordinary chat.
answers: Please do not send this temporary password through an ordinary chat.
Please don't send this temporary password through an ordinary chat.
items.notes: temporary：临时的。

items.zh: 二维码把我带到了一个与公司名称不符的网址。
items.en: The QR code took me to a web address that does not match the company name.
answers: The QR code took me to a web address that does not match the company name.
The QR code took me to a web address that doesn't match the company name.
items.notes: take sb to：将人导向某处。

items.zh: 我需要导出联系人，以便转移到另一台设备。
items.en: I need to export my contacts so that I can transfer them to another device.
answers: I need to export my contacts so that I can transfer them to another device.
items.notes: export 与 transfer 分别指导出和转移。

items.zh: 这次更新改变了菜单位置，我找不到原来的选项。
items.en: This update moved the menu, and I cannot find the old option.
answers: This update moved the menu, and I cannot find the old option.
This update moved the menu, and I can't find the old option.
items.notes: option：可选择的设置项。

items.zh: 如果开启字幕，录制视频里也会包含字幕吗？
items.en: If captions are enabled, will they also appear in the recorded video?
answers: If captions are enabled, will they also appear in the recorded video?
items.notes: captions：字幕。

items.zh: 文件名里的特殊字符可能导致上传失败。
items.en: Special characters in the filename may be causing the upload to fail.
answers: Special characters in the filename may be causing the upload to fail.
items.notes: cause sth to do：导致某事。

items.zh: 我已经退出所有设备上的账户。
items.en: I have signed out of my account on all devices.
answers: I have signed out of my account on all devices.
items.notes: sign out of：退出账户。

items.zh: 这个通知只是提醒，还是需要我立即处理？
items.en: Is this notification just a reminder, or does it require immediate action?
answers: Is this notification just a reminder, or does it require immediate action?
items.notes: require action：需要采取行动。

items.zh: 重新连接之前，我们先确认线缆没有松动。
items.en: Before reconnecting, let's make sure the cable is secure.
answers: Before reconnecting, let's make sure the cable is secure.
items.notes: secure 在此表示连接牢固。
